description: Work with public crypto addresses: op=detect (which chains/formats an address fits), validate (address + chain), convert (address to another chain's format, e.g. BTC→LTC), cashaddr_to_legacy / legacy_to_cashaddr / cashaddr_decode / cashaddr_encode (Bitcoin Cash; prefix for to_cashaddr; encode takes kind p2pkh|p2sh + hash hex [+ prefix]), to_script (address+chain → scriptPubKey hex), from_script (script hex+chain → address), base58_encode (hex data) / base58_decode (base58 data). convert accepts optional from chain. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: address_tool
title: Address detect / validate / convert / script (dev tool)
